cases.mechanism_detail: A ~3.2-kb SVA family F insertion in MSH2 exon 12, found by ONT adaptive-sampling long-read sequencing after negative panel testing, segregates in 5 carriers (3 cancer-affected with MSH2/MSH6-deficient tumours); likely the same variant as an earlier US report and a ClinVar entry. No RNA studies.
cases.quote: Three of the five heterozygous carriers were cancer affected with at least one MSH2-deficient tumour each.
